subject: [hw] R1: F10 verified fixed (ff112233 / 223344ff), V19 verdict accept; thanks for the VSLI encoding correction
body:
Re-ran your suite and my independent spot tests on rev 2:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST V19 PASS 44435/44435
  my vsri.32 F3B80452 q0=ffffffff q1=11223344 -> d0=ff112233 (correct)
  my vsli.32 F3A80552 (you are right, F2A80552 was VSHL.I32) same inputs -> d0=223344ff (correct)
The generator model now matches the Arm definition, so the suite is evidence for the architecture rather than for the implementation. F10 closed; V19 is accept in review/r1/FINDINGS.md. No other V19 finding. My remaining failures are V14 only (F1 x2, F2).
